factor_diagnostics.value_notes: A UC Santa Barbara study of 61 wild barred surfperch measured metabolic and cardiac performance at 12, 16, 20 and 22 °C. Aerobic performance remained relatively stable from 12-20 °C, while temperatures above 20 °C were limiting, especially for smaller young-of-year fish. This supports a thermal response but is not a field-derived SST preference or catch curve; the configured 12-21 °C range and 14-19 °C ideal are not directly calibrated.
